title: LAX, Gate 35
content: We arrived at LAX an hour and a half before my flight yesterday, so I painted this study of the aircraft at the gate. It's about 5x8 inches in aPentalic watercolor journal.I used just four colors: white, black, cadmium yellow deep, and ultramarine. Those colors gave me acomplementary gamutwith warm and cool contrasts, and an interesting dull green.Halfway through the painting, I was disappointed to see the aircraft depart. My model was gone. But I got lucky. Another identical airplane arrived to take its place, so I could finish the study.To see a detailed step by step, with all the stages of this painting, check outmy Facebook page.
